numericAdmission.risk: Windows PowerShell ConvertFrom-Json commonly materializes JSON integers as Int64; Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7 must be verified. V2 never reached these checks because reserved $host failed first.
numericAdmission.impact: Valid generated receipts may be rejected before admission when counts are Int64, despite values 0 or 3.
numericAdmission.requiredFix: Use a helper that accepts only integral Int32 or Int64 values, rejects bool, Double, Decimal, and Single, and enforces expected range/value; apply to positiveCases, nativeCalls, compilerInvocations, nativeWindows, and proof counts.
numericAdmission.requiredControls: Add positive Int64 receipt fixture plus rejected bool, Double/Decimal, and out-of-range fixtures; run under intended Windows PowerShell 5.1 and 7 before compiler.

decision: Do not clear root controls/build until numeric admission typing is proven or fixed; preserve pre-repair and v2 histories.
